name: Haven Constructions
awwwardsEvidence: Search snippets of Awwwards category listings: 'Haven Constructions — Dobre Agency — Honorable Mention, Jun 10, 2026'. No /sites/ page found; Awwwards unreachable. Live footer credits 'jtb', not Dobre Agency, so the live site <-> award match is unconfirmed.

observed.layout: Full-width wordmark hero (no photo, no h1); fixed centered 'Menu' pill; scroll-pinned image that grows between the words 'Bespoke' and 'Luxury'; 'label | paragraph' two-column value rows with square bullets; featured projects with name + year; full brand-blue footer repeating the wordmark.
observed.typography: Single family 'fontSuisse' at weight 400 only (verified via computed style + document.fonts). Body 14.7/22px; h2 47.5px with -1.9px tracking desktop, 28.7px mobile. Hierarchy by size only.
observed.imagery: Close-up material textures (stone, timber light), finished interiors, one candid photo of builder with clients.
observed.interaction: Lenis smooth scroll detected; scroll-pinned image scale sequence observed across sequential screenshots; unchanged under prefers-reduced-motion emulation. Hover not tested.
observed.responsive: Mobile first screen is mostly empty with the wordmark low; ~7 swipes before content. Phone/email links exist only inside the menu.

whyItWorks: Extreme scale contrast in one typeface gives a premium, confident identity with almost no assets; factual captions (project, year, EST., city) act as quiet proof.
principles: When photos are weak, set the business name as a full-width typographic hero.
One family, hierarchy by size and spacing only.
Place quiet facts (established year, city) at hero corners.
Use 'label | paragraph' rows for values or process.
Caption work with name + year/location, no adjectives.
End with a full brand-colour footer block.
doNotCarryOver: Missing h1 and hidden phone (conversion/SEO loss).
Multi-viewport pinned intros, especially on mobile.

name: Tandjung Sari
awwwardsEvidence: Search snippets of Awwwards Hotel/Restaurant, Hotel booking and Indonesia listings: 'Tandjung Sari — Fleava — Honorable Mention, Aug 05, 2026'. Live footer says 'Website by Fleava.' (consistent). Award page itself not loaded.

observed.layout: Desktop: horizontal track driven by the wheel (document height = viewport). Story told as full-bleed photo -> huge year '1960's,' -> archival photos on a thin timeline with diamond markers -> long-form serif text. Left rail with seal, menu, vertical WHATSAPP link; BOOK ROOM / BOOK TABLE fixed top-right.
observed.typography: Verified via computed style: headings 'Adobe Caslon Pro' 400 (h2 up to 176px), body/UI Helvetica 15/24px, Optima also loaded; small uppercase letter-spaced labels.
observed.imagery: Own archival sepia photos plus warm colour photos of the property and dining; no stock look.
observed.interaction: Full-screen cookie modal must be accepted; horizontal wheel-driven scroll observed; on mobile, scrolling past a chapter's end continued into the next page (title changed to Bungalows). Reduced-motion emulation did not change the horizontal scroll. Hover not tested.
observed.responsive: Mobile switches to vertical stacking and moves the two actions into a fixed bottom bar (BOOK ROOM | BOOK TABLE). Full-screen terracotta serif menu with grouped sub-items. No tel: link anywhere checked.

whyItWorks: Calm, atmospheric content paired with permanently visible booking actions; the business's own history and photos are the proof, with no invented claims.
principles: Keep 1-2 primary actions always visible: top-right on desktop, fixed bottom bar on mobile.
Derive a warm palette from the photography (cream ground, brown-grey text, one earthy accent).
Serif display + neutral sans body for hospitality.
Turn owner-supplied dates into a short timeline 'story' section.
Group menu/offers by occasion with a 'View menu' link.

name: Kümmerlein Lawyers & Notaries
awwwardsEvidence: WebSearch result title 'Kümmerlein Lawyers & Notaries - Awwwards Honorable Mention' at that URL; snippet date Jun 18, 2025. Page not loaded (Awwwards unreachable). No agency credit on live site.

observed.layout: Rounded inset photo-card hero with serif headline overlay and a lime circle in a corner notch; floating pill nav; pinned 'why us' sequence with large circles; two pill entry points (practice areas / industries); one soft CTA 'Unverbindlich kennenlernen'; partner chips; insights carousel; full-lime footer.
observed.typography: Verified via computed style + document.fonts: 'Rhymes Display Light' (h1 74px / mobile 30px), 'ABC Monument Grotesk Regular' text 18/21px, 'ABC Monument Grotesk Semi-Mono' 12px uppercase labels, Monument Bold for some h3.
observed.imagery: Candid, shallow-depth photos of lawyers with clients in warm light.
observed.interaction: Cookie banner accepted; pinned scroll sequence (circle labels change per step) observed across screenshots, unchanged under reduced-motion emulation; fixed nav overlapped headline text in one frame. Hover not tested.
observed.responsive: Mobile splits hero into photo card + separate lime text card; footer link groups become accordions. No tel: link or form on homepage.

whyItWorks: A traditionally cold category made approachable with real people, plain-language promise, one cheerful accent and a small repeatable system of rounded cards and pills.
principles: Professional services: candid photo of people + plain-language promise as h1.
One saturated accent for CTAs, highlights and footer; everything else neutral.
On mobile, put the hero image and the hero text in separate stacked cards.
Team as compact chips (photo, name, role) only with owner-supplied people.
One soft CTA wording repeated consistently.
Collapse footer link groups into accordions on mobile.
doNotCarryOver: Text hidden behind pinned scroll steps.
Their logo, lime/sage palette as-is, commercial fonts.

name: LPAS Architecture + Interiors
awwwardsEvidence: Conflicting search snippets: architecture/portfolio listings say 'LPAS — Site of the Day, Oct 10, 2026'; a summary of /sites/lpas says 'Nominee, Aug 30, 2026'. Not resolved (page unreachable). Live footer: 'Website by Naam'.

observed.layout: Preloader, full-bleed photo hero with h1 revealed on scroll; five focus areas as horizontal panels (photo + flat muted colour block + title + tagline + 'n / 5' + '+' + sub-links); manifesto; work grid with category tabs showing counts; Instagram updates; dark footer with one block per office (address, tel, email).
observed.typography: Verified: single family Aeonik, weights 400 and 600 loaded; h1 75px / line-height 1.0 (46px mobile); body 14px.
observed.imagery: Professional architectural photography, daylight, people small in frame.
observed.interaction: Horizontal panel scroll on desktop observed; still active under reduced-motion emulation. Mobile menu: full-screen dark grouped menu whose items appear with a staggered blur/fade (caught mid-transition in a still). Hover not tested.
observed.responsive: Panels become vertically stacked colour cards with thumbnails on mobile; footer office blocks stack; tel: links present.

whyItWorks: Colour fields separate services without icons or borders; each service card carries photo, promise and sub-services, and the system degrades cleanly to stacked cards on phones.
principles: Render services as colour-field cards: photo + name + one-liner + 2-4 sub-items.
Derive a set of muted tints from the theme to colour each service.
Desktop row of tall cards; mobile vertical stack — no horizontal scroll.
Footer location block per address: city, street, tel, email.
Show filter tabs with counts only when data has categories.
doNotCarryOver: Hero message only on a darkened full-bleed photo on small screens.

name: Attio
awwwardsEvidence: WebSearch result title 'Attio - Awwwards Honorable Mention', snippet date Apr 6, 2021. The live site inspected is the 2026 redesign, NOT the awarded version.

observed.layout: Centered h1 + 2 CTAs + large framed app window; bordered logo grid; long chapters with a sticky left index (active item dark) and per-chapter demos built from real UI pieces (record table, email draft, workflow graph, kanban); serif testimonial; changelog cards; dark mega-footer.
observed.typography: Verified: interDisplay (h1 64px/600, -1.28px), inter (UI/body), tiemposText (quotes), JetBrains Mono.
observed.imagery: No photos in the demo areas; rendered product UI at readable size.
observed.interaction: Sticky header (116px); sticky chapter index updates with scroll (seen across frames). Cookie card not dismissed and covers part of frames. Hover not tested.
observed.responsive: Side index becomes a horizontal tab strip that advances with scroll; hero CTA becomes email field + 'Send me a demo'.

whyItWorks: Every benefit sentence is paired with the actual product object it refers to, and the sticky index makes a long page navigable.
principles: Demonstrate the product with real UI components, one per benefit sentence.
One chapter per step of the user flow.
Sticky step index on desktop becomes horizontal step tabs on mobile.
Two-tone headings: dark claim + grey explanation in one sentence.
doNotCarryOver: Overlays that cover the demo on mobile.

name: Anime.js
awwwardsEvidence: WebSearch result title 'Anime.js - Awwwards SOTD' (score 7.62 in snippet); date not established; current live version may differ from the awarded one.

observed.layout: Dark page; hero headline left with a scroll-scrubbed animated dial demo; each feature (Intuitive API, Scroll Observer, Staggering, SVG toolset…) is a pinned full-screen live demo with a short title, one line of text, a code snippet panel and a timeline scrubber; link grid to docs; footer with sponsor and newsletter.
observed.typography: Verified: DIN (headings/body) and a monospace 'Mono' for code/buttons.
observed.imagery: No photos; all visuals are live canvas/DOM demos (6 canvas elements).
observed.interaction: Demo state changes with scroll position (seen across sequential frames). Not tested for hover/reduced motion beyond a first-frame screenshot.
observed.responsive: Mobile keeps pinned demos with title above and a scrubber below.

whyItWorks: The feature section is the product running: each claim is immediately proved by a live demo plus the exact snippet that produced it.
principles: Pair each feature claim with the artifact that proves it (live demo + the input that produced it).
Keep feature copy to a title and one line beside the demo.
doNotCarryOver: Dark techy aesthetic and heavy pinned sections — wrong for busy small-business owners.
Scroll-scrubbed demos as the only way to see content.

name: Café Binocle
awwwardsEvidence: Only a WebSearch summary of the Awwwards Cafe listing: 'Café Binocle received [an Honorable Mention] on Apr 21, 2026'. No /sites/ page found; not verified.

observed.layout: Shopify site; warm yellow ground; condensed display wordmark with a rotating circular badge; bordered rows/cards with round arrow buttons; big uppercase manifesto paragraph; 'Où nous trouver?' (where to find us) pill with map pin; contact card with newsletter + 'Écrivez-nous'.
observed.typography: Verified: 'caprasimo' (display h2 76px), 'FoundersGroteskRegular/Medium' (text), 'Cimo', Assistant (theme UI). No h1 on homepage.
observed.imagery: Flat retro illustrations (globe, flowers, smiling face), product shots of coffee bags and merch.
observed.interaction: GSAP present; only light inspection (screenshots while scrolling).
observed.responsive: Stacks cleanly; persistent header with Abonnement pill, cart, Menu circle.

whyItWorks: A strong, cheerful personality from a tiny kit: one ground colour, one display face, outlined cards and simple illustrations.
principles: For playful food businesses: one bold ground colour + one chunky display face + outlined cards.
Make 'where to find us' a prominent, distinct element.

name: Campos Coffee
awwwardsEvidence: WebSearch result title 'Campos Coffee - Awwwards Honorable Mention', snippet date Oct 11, 2016. The current live site is certainly a later version.

observed.layout: Promo hero (competition), 'Meet the Campos Locals', cafe finder; most frames obscured by a cookie panel plus a '10% off' newsletter modal that stayed open while scrolling.
observed.typography: Verified: 'Adieu' (uppercase h1 28px), Archivo (text/UI), Radio Canada Big loaded.
observed.imagery: Cafe and barista photography, kraft/cream tones.
observed.interaction: Two overlapping overlays on load; page content largely hidden in screenshots.
observed.responsive: Not meaningfully assessed because of overlays.

whyItWorks: Not assessable from this inspection; kept as a cautionary example.
principles: Never stack a cookie banner and a marketing modal on first load.
doNotCarryOver: Interstitial newsletter modal on first visit.
